newsitem.title: EGYPT: Nile bus death toll in Egypt at least 30.
newsitem.headline: Nile bus death toll in Egypt at least 30.

text.p: Rescue workers have pulled at least 30 dead people out of a public transport bus that went off a bridge in Cairo on Tuesday and partly sank on a bank of the Nile River, a rescue official said.

Major-General Omar al-Bnaway told Reuters that at least 32 people were injured among the 70 who police believe were on the bus when it sped off the bridge. Some passengers walked away from the accident in the north Cairo neighbourhood of Rod al-Farag.
